material_review_discoveries: Parent source identity must use ancestry and exact parent Git blobs rather than require revision HEAD equality.
Midflight checking is a pre-lease trigger barrier, not a job after research.
The factory proposes profiles; only a qualified controller may dispatch or own a lease.
Changed evidence cannot reset cumulative audit, role, assignment, budget, or recovery ceilings.
Jewish representation, translation fidelity, source rights/custody, and destination readiness add unique checks beyond generic doctrine roles.
Risk tags, materiality, decision bundles, actor lineage, and human receipts must remain separate and conservatively computed.
A schema or contract is a dormant interface until semantic validators, adversarial fixtures, qualified adapters, and exact human authority exist.
Actual high-signal source packs remain unbuilt and cannot be replaced by a taxonomy label, model memory, source catalog, or provider prestige.
